name: byo-guardrail
description:
Checks request or response body text with your own guardrail service over HTTP, with no policy code to write.
The service implements a small, versioned contract and returns allow, block, or modify (replace the checked text).
Supports bearer or raw token authentication via secret references, a configurable timeout, enforce and monitor modes, explicit fail-closed or fail-open behaviour, JSONPath extraction, and separate request and response configuration. Configuring response checks disables streaming on the route.
